messages:
Aisha: Quick: can we schedule a HelixThera enablement drop-in next week? They want 3 parallel mini-tracks: integrations (SDK + webhooks), Dedicated migration checklist, and Private/VPC security preflight. Prefer 60m per track. Need to land times and facilitators. /cc @Lina @Tom
Lina: OK. I can run integrations or co-host. Wed/Thu morning PT work?
Tom: I'm tied up Wed morning. Thu 10am PT works for me. Would prefer integrations on Thu so I can cover rollout tips.
Jorge (Customer): Thu 6pm CET would be ideal for our EMEA team, can we do one session in the evening?
Lina: Hmm. If we split: Thu 10am PT (integrations + rollout), Wed 5pm PT (dedicated migration), Thu 6pm CET (private/VPC). That gives Jorge an evening slot.
Aisha: That split looks workable. We need facilitators: Lina for integrations, Tom for rollout + migration? @Raj to lead Dedicated migration deep-dive?
Raj: I can take dedicated migration Wed 5pm PT. Confirmed.
ops-bot: Created provisional calendar blocks: https://cal.example.com/helix-3tracks — please accept. (automated)
Tom: Added pre-reads: 1) migration runbook draft https://docs.redwood/helix/migration-v1 2) VPC checklist (short). I'll post in the thread.
Lina: I'll prepare 2 short demos + one sample webhook snippet. Snippet:
```
POST /events
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Aisha: We'll capture feedback via this form: https://forms.gle/helix-feedback. Please remind attendees to complete it. :memo: 
Jorge (Customer): Thanks — I'll invite product + infra. One ask: can we record sessions?
Aisha: Yes, record on unless any sensitive configs. We'll redact any customer secrets. @Tom can you enable recording?
Tom: Will enable recording and add note in invites. :white_check_mark: 
Lina: Heads-up — need a laptop + ethernet for demos. Anyone on dry-run?
Aisha: Dry-run Monday 11am PT. Lina, Raj, Tom, me. 30min. Confirm?
Lina: Confirmed.
Raj: Confirmed.
Jorge (Customer): I'll join the dry-run to test recording.
Aisha: Perfect — I'll send invites and update CS playbook with session links & feedback form. Tagging action items:
- Aisha: send invites + CS playbook update
- Tom: enable recording + post VPC checklist
- Lina: demo + webhook snippet
- Raj: migration checklist + runbook
- Jorge: attendee list + join dry-run

Thanks all! :tada:
